newsitem.title: USA: Goldman seen close to buying Commodities Corp - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Goldman seen close to buying Commodities Corp - WSJ.

text.p: Goldman, Sachs & Co is close to acquiring asset manager Commodities Corp for about $100 million, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Monday.
The paper, citing people close to the firms, said the terms were not yet final. Commodities Corp, a unit of privately-held Stockton Holdings Ltd, managed nearly $2 billion in assets, the paper said.
People familiar with the situation said an agreement was expected to be reached this week, the paper said.
The acquisition would not include Stockton's reinsurance unit, the paper said.
